title: The Lord's army from the ends of the earth
description: The prophet Isaiah describes how the Lord raises a banner and whistles for a foreign nation from the ends of the earth. An invincible army comes swiftly: none grow weary, their arrows are sharp, and the hooves of their horses are like flint. They roar like lions and seize the prey, and over the land comes darkness and distress [ref:Jes 5:26-30|Isaiah 5:26-30].
